# stalwart_symmetric_key (Data Source)

Defines a symmetric key used to encrypt blobs at rest. Blobs encrypted with a key cannot be read without it, so keys can only be deleted by the recovery administrator.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `cipher` (String) Encryption algorithm, which cannot be changed after the key is created
- `description` (String) Description of the key
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key, used to detect a changed key file or environment variable
- `key` (Attributes) Base64-encoded 256-bit key (for example, generated with `openssl rand -base64 32`), which cannot be changed after the key is created (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--key))

<a id="nestedatt--key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `key`

Read-Only:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
